# Recommended GitHub Topics for Entity Repository

## Add these topics to your GitHub repository for better discoverability:

### Primary Topics (Most Important)
- cybersecurity
- ethical-hacking
- network-security
- security-tools
- penetration-testing
- osint
- python-security
- student-project

### Educational Focus
- learning-project
- cybersecurity-education
- security-learning
- beginner-friendly
- educational-project

### Technical Topics
- port-scanner
- network-scanner
- vulnerability-scanner
- python3
- security-assessment
- information-gathering

### Platform Coverage
- cross-platform
- windows
- linux
- termux

### Specific Features
- phishing-detection
- ip-geolocation
- banner-grabbing
- whois-lookup
- social-media-osint

## How to Add Topics:

1. Go to your repository on GitHub
2. Click "About" (top right, under the Code button)
3. Click the gear icon ⚙️
4. Add topics in the "Topics" field
5. Choose 5-10 relevant topics (don't overdo it)

## Recommended Combination (10 topics max):

cybersecurity, ethical-hacking, network-security, security-tools, osint, python-security, student-project, port-scanner, educational-project, penetration-testing
